In the letter read above, the Project Director, Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project has stated that the District Collector, Kallakurichi has requested for integration of a newly received Basic Life Support (BLS) Ambulance into the existing 108 Emergency Ambulance Services for the benefit of the tribal population residing in the remote areas of Kalvarayan Hills.

2. The Kalvarayan Hills area has a tribal population of about 66,000 with limited access to healthcare facilities and faces significant health challenges, including high maternal and infant mortality rates, malnourishment, and poor transport infrastructure. The region is also prone to wild animal bites, insect stings, snake bites, and road traffic accidents. He has further stated that the existing two ambulances are insufficient to meet the requirements of the area, and that a maternal death had earlier occurred due to delay in ambulance services, as the ambulance was engaged in transporting another patient at that time. Hence, timely mobilization of ambulance services is crucial for saving the lives of the tribal population who largely depend on Government health services.

3. Based on the essential need for an additional ambulance, one Basic Life Support (BLS) type ambulance, Force Traveller T1 Ambulance (Reg. No. TN15MJ2356), was received through POWER GRID _ Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funding on 09.04.2025 for Kalvarayan Hills.

4. The District Collector, Kallakurichi, has requested that necessary arrangements be made for the integration of the newly received Basic Life Support (BLS) Type Ambulance into the existing 108 Emergency Ambulance Services in Kalvarayan Hills.

5. The Project Director, Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project has therefore requested the Government to consider the request of the District Collector, Kallakurichi with permission to include Basic Life Support (BLS) Ambulance donated under C.S.R activities in the existing fleet strength.

6. The Government after careful examination, decided to accept the request of the Project Director, Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project and accordingly the Project Director, Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project is permitted:-

i. To accept one Basic Life Support (BLS) Ambulance donated under C.S.R activities in the existing fleet strength in Kalvarayan Hills; ii. To bear the operational costs for further usage under 108 services; ili. To render assistance to complete the formalities for ambulances inducted in regular operation.
